basic_info.description: Green thumb? Pets? Outdoor Yoga? Dining al fresco? This is the place for you! The convenience of a condo with a huge patio typically only found in single family homes. You'll forget you are in the center of the city when you enter this quiet courtyard condo. The open concept great room allows for separate dining and living zones and seamlessly opens to the ~25' wide patio ideal for indoor/outdoor living. Whether you are a delivery aficionado or aspiring chef, you'll be right at home in the fully equipped kitchen. The large bedroom complete with an office nook has serene patio outlooks. The bath is accessible directly from the bedroom creating an ensuite and has a 2nd door off the entry for guest access. The super-sized 6' vanity loaded with storage and shower over tub is the perfect oasis. Tons of storage: 3 closets in the bedroom, entry closet and patio storage. The condo includes in-unit laundry and 1-car pkg. Residents enjoy 24x7 doorman security, package service, gym, hot tub, sauna, shared outdoor space and grand library lobby. Large HOA reserves. Lafayette Park, Polk St. Japan Town, Fillmore St. Hayes Valley, SF Opera, Jazz, Symphony, all a stroll away. Whole Foods 2-blocks, Trader Joe's nearby. Tech shuttles and MUNI within steps. Turn-key condo, can be avail furnished!
